name: cdcx-cli
description: AI-weighted trade analysis engine for Crypto.com markets -- combines EMA/ATR, ADX, Bollinger Bands, RSI, Fibonacci, Fair Value Gap, Volume Profile, and Market Structure into a single 0-100 scored trade signal with entry, stop loss, and take-profit targets. Also includes multi-timeframe (1H/4H/1D/1W) confluence execution planning and local paper-trade tracking (1.5x ATR stop, 2% account risk, break-even/trailing-stop rules) -- no live order routing.
